QUOTE: "`MBEDTLS_TEST_CONSTANT_FLOW_VALGRIND`: runs the constant-time suites under Valgrind memcheck... `MBEDTLS_TEST_CONSTANT_FLOW_MEMSAN`: the same idea with Clang MemorySanitizer... Neither runs by default in a normal build."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer covers the valgrind/MemSan opt-in testing facility, but it never says the facility is explicitly not part of the library API. Its only API remark concerns `mbedtls_ct_memcmp` being public.
